name: QalamMR
summary:
QalamMR is the first mixed reality Arabic calligraphy application for Meta Quest, built around the **Logitech MX Ink** stylus. The MX Ink becomes a virtual reed pen (qalam) with authentic ink behavior: pressure controls opacity and ink consumption, pen roll transitions between wide and narrow nib edges, and haptic feedback guides your strokes through carved letter grooves.
